name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedGGH15.masked_two_vector
title: Open: the masked two-vector lemma of the masked gamma-tensor GGH15 WE candidate (PR #45)
statement: Masked gamma-tensor GGH15 (secrets diag(R_i, M_{i,b} (x) S'_{i,b}, S_{i,b}), bit-independent R_i, CNF branching program M of CVW18 Construction 6.4, two left vectors J_O A_0 and J_C A_0 with a rank-one difference). If Psi is unsatisfiable and decision LWE has k bits at parameters pL in the CVW18 regime, then (J_O A_0, J_C A_0, {D_{i,b}}, mask) with mask = (r_0 R_*) A_h^mask and the same view with a uniform vector instead of the mask satisfy: every machine has 2^k * gain <= (2^h * hopLoss(h, rows))^2 * (cost + simCost), i.e. loss 2^h * poly(h) * eps_LWE.
